wiki_enchanted_turtle_helmet_desc: Grants Water Breathing for 4 minutes. Effect resets only after being out of water for 1 minute.
wiki_shark_desc: Hostile ocean predator (Y 60–80 in groups of 1–3), pursues players when it sees them, circles for 30s if they leave the water, eats dropped items after 3s.
wiki_shark_meta: Health: 28 (14 hearts) · Damage: 5 · Speed: 1.6 · Range: 24 blocks

world_dim_desc: A flat world of infinite water with a raft at the center (0, 90, 0).
world_barrel_desc: The starting raft contains a barrel with an unbreakable fishing rod. Starting at Stage 4, the rod begins taking durability damage like a normal fishing rod.
world_current_desc: Players are slowly pushed southward. Max speed: 0.012.
world_islands_desc: Islands are scattered across the ocean in three sizes — small, medium, and large. Iron and coal deposits lie hidden within them, and hostile creatures may appear at night, meaning dry land is not entirely safe.
world_mobs_desc: Hostile mobs spawn in the water and on islands after dark, but never on the raft or other player-built structures.
world_loot_desc: Every 40 ticks a floating item appears. The first 10 are "fast".
faq_a1: Use /startraft in the Overworld. You'll be teleported to the Raft dimension.
faq_a2: A block that automatically catches floating items. Has 9 inventory slots.
faq_a3: Complete objectives: get the Raft Net, farm 10 wheat, craft stone tools, and smelt 5 iron ingots...
faq_q4: Why can't I move at the start?
faq_a4: The mod applies slowness and blindness until you use /startraft or leave the dimension.
faq_a5: The first 10 items that spawn have the raftworld_fast tag and move faster toward you.
faq_q6: Can I go back to the Overworld?
faq_a6: Yes, using a portal or with /execute in minecraft:overworld run tp @s ~ ~ ~ (requires permissions).
faq_q7: I found a bug. How can I report it?
faq_a7: Please report bugs or unexpected behavior on
faq_q8: Does the starting fishing rod ever break?
faq_a8: It starts out unbreakable, but from Stage 4 (smelting 5 iron ingots) onward it behaves like a normal fishing rod and can lose durability.
